_readme: Source of truth for the Downloads page and the /download/<id>[/<platform>] direct links. Edit this file, then run: node _tools/build-downloads.mjs. To launch a product: set status to "live" and give each platform its installer url. To move a product to its own site: change website to its plannedWebsite once that site is up.
